english.title: Consignor of animal / genetic material fail to notify member State 24 hours in advance of consignment's arrival

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: trade in animals and related products regulations 2011

english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) consigned to another member State

(A)_[an animal,]_
(B)_[animals,]_
(C)_[genetic material,]_

namely, **(..SPECIFY THE NATURE OF THE ANIMAL(S) OR GENETIC MATERIAL..), having failed to notify the competent authority of the member State of destination, namely **(.. SPECIFY STATE OF DESTINATION..), at least 24 hours in advance of the intended arrival of the consignment and using the Traces system established under Commission Decision 2004/292/EC
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 7(1), 39 and 42(2) of the Trade in Animals and Related Products Regulations 2011.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
consign to another member State
animal / genetic material
failed to notify the competent authority
24 hours in advance

investigatoraction.description: Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine not exceeding the statutory maximum
Indictment: A fine

Time limit for prosecutions:
None

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
